lines.japanese: もうちょっと続くよ。
lines.english: Just a little more.

lines.japanese: 「はっ！　あれは！」
lines.english: “Ah! Look!”

lines.japanese: そのとき俺は衝撃を受けた。
lines.english: At that moment, I received a shock.

lines.japanese: この薄汚れた地上の片隅で、はるか天空の御殿におわすはずの美しき女神とまみえてしまったからだ。
lines.english: There in one corner of this filthy mortal realm, I had encountered a beautiful goddess who should have dwelled in a palace far above the heavens.

lines.japanese: 「わわ、こんな時間なのにすごくにぎやかあだなあ……」
lines.english: “Wow. It's so crowded, even this late...”

lines.japanese: 「あれっ？　吉川さんどこ？　よよ、吉川さーんっ」
lines.english: “Wait. Where's Yoshikawa? Y-Yoshikawaaa!”

lines.japanese: 女神さまは雑踏の中、たおやかなその身をはかなげに震わせていらっしゃった。
lines.english: In the midst of the crowd, the goddess's graceful body trembled with delicate fragility.

lines.japanese: 「は、羽田さーんっ！」
lines.english: “H-Hanedaaa!”

lines.japanese: 「はあ、怖かった……はぐれちゃうかと思った。怖いから、手繋いで歩こう？」
lines.english: “Oh, that was scary... I thought we were going to get separated. I'm scared, so can we hold hands while we walk?”

lines.japanese: おや、あれは吉川さんじゃないか。へえ、すごいな、彼女は地上人でありながら人智を超越した存在とお友達だったのか。
lines.english: Oh, was that Yoshikawa? Incredible. Though a mortal, she was friends with a being who transcended human understanding.

lines.japanese: って、ああッ！　よくよく見たら、あれは女神じゃなくてうちの小鳩じゃないか！　なあんだ、瓜二つだから気付かなかったよ。
lines.english: Wait! On closer inspection, that wasn't a goddess at all. It was our own Kobato! Of course. They looked so identical that I hadn't recognized her.

lines.japanese: 「なに？　どうかしたのパラボラアンテナくん」
lines.english: “What? Something wrong, Parabolic Antenna?”

lines.japanese: 思わず立ちつくしていたら、再合流した前脚こと渡来明日香が不審がっていた。
lines.english: I had stopped dead without realizing it, and Asuka Watarai—the front legs, now reunited with me—was regarding me suspiciously.

lines.japanese: 「ああいや、ちょっとな。微笑みひとつで世界経済すら揺るがしかねない絶世の美女を観察……あッ！」
lines.english: “Oh, nothing. I was simply observing a peerless beauty whose smile could shake the global economy... Ah!”

lines.japanese: 俺が薄汚れた地上の民を相手しているうちに、女神のような小鳩たちが移動を開始した。
lines.english: While I was occupied with the filthy mortals of this world, the goddess-like Kobato and her friend began to move.

lines.japanese: い、いかん、こんなションベン女とくっちゃべってる場合じゃない。
lines.english: Th-this was bad. I had no time to stand around chatting with some snot-nosed brat.

lines.japanese: か弱いふたりがもし俺の目の届かないところへ迷いこんでしまったら、悪い虫が寄ってきたとき誰が守ってやれるというんだ。
lines.english: If those two frail girls wandered beyond my sight, who would protect them when the creeps came crawling?

lines.japanese: 「おい前脚、俺たちも行くぞ、急げ」
lines.english: “Front legs, we're following them. Hurry.”

lines.japanese: 「だわっ！？　ちょ、押すな押すな、なに、どこ行けっての」
lines.english: “Dwah?! Hey, quit pushing! Where are you trying to make me go?”

lines.japanese: 「うむ、どうやら賽銭を投げに行くみたいだな」
lines.english: “Hmm. They appear to be on their way to make an offering.”

lines.japanese: 「はあ？」
lines.english: “Huh?”

lines.japanese: 「ねえ羽田さん、細かいお金用意してきた？」
lines.english: “Hey, Haneda, did you bring any change?”

lines.japanese: 「うん！　えへへ、私、十円玉いっぱい作ってきちゃった」
lines.english: “Yeah! Hee-hee. I made sure to get a whole lot of ten-yen coins.”

lines.japanese: ああ小鳩さんったら、賽銭は数投げりゃ偉いってわけでもないのにそんな得意げな顔で……。
lines.english: Oh, Kobato. Tossing more coins into the offering box did not make you more virtuous, yet you looked so proud...

lines.japanese: 「わあ、羽田さんすごーい」
lines.english: “Wow, Haneda, you're amazing.”

lines.japanese: ううん、何もすごくないよ吉川さん。ぜんぜん驚く必要ないよ。君のその純粋さは、素でショッピング番組のサクラが勤まるレベルだね。
lines.english: No, Yoshikawa, there was nothing amazing about it. No need to be so impressed. You were so innocent you could be a planted audience member on a shopping show without even putting on an act.

lines.japanese: 「私もたくさん崩してきたんだけど、ぜんぶ五円玉だもん。十円なんて羽田さんすごーい、お金もちー、ワルシャワだー」
lines.english: “I got lots of change too, but mine are all five-yen coins. You’ve got tens, Haneda! Amazing! You’re rich! You’re boogie-woogie!”

lines.japanese: ううっ、だから吉川さんも……賽銭は一枚でいいんだってば……。
lines.english: Oof. You too, Yoshikawa... You only need one coin for an offering...

lines.japanese: 俺は目頭が熱くなるのを抑えきれなかった。
lines.english: I could not keep my eyes from growing hot.

lines.japanese: 悪くない、この子たちは何も悪くない。
lines.english: These girls were not at fault. They had done nothing wrong.

lines.japanese: 悪いのは正しい子供を育てられなかった大人たちだ。「ブルジョワ」をちょっぴり間違えて覚えちゃった子も、その間違いにまったく気付く様子のない子も、みんなみんな悪くなんかないんだ……！
lines.english: The adults who had failed to teach them were at fault. The girl who had learned ‘bourgeois’ as ‘boogie-woogie,’ and the girl who showed no sign of noticing—neither of them had done anything wrong...!

lines.japanese: 「え、今度はなに、パリジェンヌくん。なんかしきりに鼻をすすってる音が聞こえるんだけど」
lines.english: “What is it now, Parisienne? I keep hearing you sniffle in there.”

lines.japanese: 「泣いてない！　ちっとも泣いてなんかないやい！」
lines.english: “I'm not crying! I'm not crying at all!”

lines.japanese: 俺は涙をぬぐって決意した。ああ、やはりあの子たちは、きちんと俺が見守ってあげねば。
lines.english: I wiped my tears and made a decision. Yes. As I thought, those girls needed me to watch over them properly.

lines.japanese: うん、というわけでちょっと後に付いてってみよう。いや、これは兄として年長者として当然の好意であって、べつに俺シスコンとかストーカーとか全然ないけどね。そう、それだ。
lines.english: So I would follow them for a little while. This was the natural kindness of an older brother and an adult. I had no sister complex and was certainly no stalker. Yes. That was it.

lines.japanese: 「あ、見て羽田さん、たこ焼き屋さんだよ。おいしそーだねー」
lines.english: “Oh, look, Haneda. A takoyaki stand. That looks good.”

lines.japanese: 「わあ、ほんとだー。ひとつ買ってこーかなー」
lines.english: “Wow, you're right. Maybe I'll buy some.”

lines.japanese: あっ、こら小鳩！　おまえもう今月の小遣い、残り少なかったはずだぞ。そんな無駄遣いはお兄ちゃん許しませんからね。
lines.english: Hey! Kobato! You were almost out of allowance for the month. Your big brother would not permit such wasteful spending.

lines.japanese: しかもこんな夜遅くにジャンクフードなんか食べたがって、とんでもない不良娘だよ！　胸をいためる兄の気持ちなんて考えたこともないんだろう！
lines.english: And wanting junk food this late at night! What a terrible delinquent of a girl! Had you ever once considered the pain in your brother's heart?!

lines.japanese: 「えへへ、お兄ちゃんに買っていってあげたら喜ぶかも」
lines.english: “Hee-hee. Maybe Big Brother would like it if I brought him some.”

lines.japanese: う、ううっ、うううううう～っ！
lines.english: O-oof! Ooooooof!

lines.japanese: 「へ？　ちょっとちょっと、なにパーキングエリアくん。なんでいきなり声を殺してむせび泣いてんの？」
lines.english: “What? Hey, what's wrong, Parking Area? Why are you suddenly choking back sobs?”

lines.japanese: 「き、聞いてくれワンダーフォーゲルさん、やはり見間違いじゃなかったんだ。俺は、俺はいま、地上の女神を目の当たりにしているッ……！」
lines.english: “L-listen, Wandervogel. My eyes did not deceive me. I am—I am witnessing a goddess upon the earth!”

lines.japanese: 「わっ、うわーあ！　きったないなあ、もう鼻水巻きちらして……あ」
lines.english: “Whoa! Ew! Gross! You're spraying snot everywhere... Oh.”

lines.japanese: ぴた、と前脚担当の動きが止まった。
lines.english: The movements of the front legs stopped dead.

lines.japanese: 「ん、なんだ、どうしたワイヤレスブラジャーさん」
lines.english: “Hm? What is it, Wireless Bra?”

lines.japanese: 「ナマハゲがいる」
lines.english: “There's a namahage.”
“What?”

lines.japanese: 「針生先輩だ」
lines.english: “It's Kuroudo.”

lines.japanese: 「なに、本当か──」
lines.english: “What? Are you certain—?”

lines.japanese: 頭をひょっこりと唐草マントの外へ出した瞬間、聞き覚えのあるダミ声の咆哮が響いた。
lines.english: The moment I poked my head out from beneath the arabesque cape, I heard the familiar roar of a gravelly voice.

lines.japanese: 「ゲッラウ泣く子！　ファッキン・ニュゥゥゥ～・Ｙｅａｈ！」
lines.english: “Get out, crying child! Fucking Neeeeeew Year!”

lines.japanese: 「ひ、ひいいっ！」
lines.english: “E-eek!”

lines.japanese: 同時に聞き覚えのある美声も聞こえた。だが聞き覚えのある美声は、恐怖に震え揺れていた。
lines.english: At the same time, I heard a familiar beautiful voice. But that voice trembled and quavered with fear.

lines.japanese: 「ごごごごめんなさい、私よい子なのでそうゆうの分かりませんっ」
lines.english: “I-I-I'm sorry! I'm a good girl, so I don't understand that sort of thing!”

lines.japanese: 「Ｉｓｎ’ｔ　ｈｅｒｅ　ｃｒｙｉｎｇ　ｃｈｉｌｄ！？　イァーハー！」
lines.english: “Isn't here crying child?! Yee-haw!”

lines.japanese: 「はっ！　まずい、このままでは小鳩が刈られる！」
lines.english: “Ah! This is bad. At this rate, Kobato will be harvested!”

lines.japanese: 俺はあわてて前脚に鞭を入れた。
lines.english: I hastily drove the front legs forward.

lines.japanese: 「そら、ゆくぞ石綿金網さん。我らの女神がファイナル・ティアドロップ・エボリューションする前に、泣く子バスター針生を止めるんだ！」
lines.english: “Go, Asbestos Mesh! Before our goddess undergoes Final Teardrop Evolution, we must stop Kuroudo the Crying-Child Buster!”

lines.japanese: 「は、はあ？　なに言ってるんだかさっぱり……」
lines.english: “Wh-what? I have no idea what you're talking about...”

lines.japanese: 「ええい馬鹿者！　早よう、早よう走らんかこのゴブリン脳が！　それっ、ハイヨー、パカラッパカラッ」
lines.english: “Run, you fool! Run, you goblin brain! Hi-yo! Clippety-clop!”

lines.japanese: 「わわ、だから押すなって……ひあああっ、やだどこ触って──」
lines.english: “Whoa, quit pushing... Hyaaah! No! Where are you touching—”

lines.japanese: 「──っと、とと、と転ぶ転ぶ！」
lines.english: “—whoa! W-we're falling!”

lines.japanese: ていうか転んだ。
lines.english: Actually, we fell.

lines.japanese: 俺たちは不様にもつれあって倒れた。
lines.english: We collapsed in an undignified tangle.

lines.japanese: 「あいっ、たたた……いやすまんノコギリクワガタさん、愛に生きいそぐあまり若干ハッスルが過ぎてしまったようだ」
lines.english: “Ow... My apologies, Sawtooth Stag Beetle. In my haste to live for love, I appear to have become slightly overexcited.”

lines.japanese: 「う、うん……いい。どいて」
lines.english: “Y-yeah... Fine. Get off.”

lines.japanese: あれ？　渡来明日香にしちゃ意外と淡白な反応だな。
lines.english: Huh? That was a surprisingly mild reaction from Asuka Watarai.

lines.japanese: いや、いいんだけど……
lines.english: Not that I minded...

lines.japanese: もっとギャーギャーねちっこく責めてくるのかと思ったら、なんか妙にしおらしく目を逸らしてるし。
lines.english: I'd expected her to scream and complain forever, but instead she was looking aside with strangely docile embarrassment.

lines.japanese: これじゃまるで、不意の急接近にどぎまぎしている乙女みたいじゃないか。
lines.english: She almost looked like a maiden flustered by our sudden physical closeness.

lines.japanese: 「ヒャハー！　なんだブッ飛んでるなァ、おまえら！　いきなり往来でおっぱじめる気かイェッヒー！」
lines.english: “Hyah-ha! You two are fucking wild! Gonna start screwing right here in the street? Yee-hee!”

lines.japanese: 頭上から奇声が降ってきた。首を曲げれば、そこには出刃包丁を派手に振りかざす赤鬼の姿。
lines.english: The jeer came from above. I bent my neck and found a red ogre brandishing a large kitchen knife with theatrical flourish.

lines.japanese: 俺はハリュー・クロードに冷やかされて初めて、自分が誤解を招きかねない体勢で女子の上に覆いかぶさっているのだと認識した。
lines.english: Only when Claude Haryuu mocked me did I realize that I was sprawled over a girl in a position ripe for misunderstanding.

lines.japanese: 「公開姫初め！？」
lines.english: “Public first fuck of the year?!”

lines.japanese: 思わず漏れでた鷲介の芸人根性、しかしそれが仇となり、俺の品性と信用はにわかに急下落した。
lines.english: Shuusuke's comedian instinct escaped my lips. It proved my undoing, and my dignity and credibility plummeted on the spot.

lines.japanese: わらわらと寄ってくる野次馬たちの目は、けだものを蔑むような鉛色だった。
lines.english: Rubberneckers gathered around us, regarding me with leaden eyes that scorned a beast.

lines.japanese: 「あっ！　いや、違う！　あの、これは違うぞ？　そういうやましいアレではなくて、単なる日常にありがちな微笑ましいうっかりハプニング──」
lines.english: “Wait! No, this isn't what it looks like! This is nothing dirty. It's merely a charming little accident of ordinary life—”

lines.japanese: 「おにい、ちゃん……？」
lines.english: “Big... Brother...?”

lines.japanese: そして女神のわななく声。ああ、でも小鳩はどんなときでも可愛い声だなあ。言ってる場合か！
lines.english: Then came the trembling voice of my goddess. Ah, Kobato's voice was adorable under any circumstances. This was no time for that!

lines.japanese: 「き、聞いてくれ小鳩、違うんだ！　あ、いや、そうだ、俺が弁解するよりも──」
lines.english: “L-listen, Kobato! You've got it wrong! No, wait. Instead of making excuses myself—”

lines.japanese: 「──おい渡来明日香、彼女たちに説明してやってくれ。これは決して思春期の男子にありがちないかがわしいうっかり等ではなく、単なる日常的なリトルハプニングだと……」
lines.english: “—Asuka Watarai, explain it to them. Tell them this wasn't the sort of dirty little mishap common among adolescent boys. It was merely an ordinary little accident...”

lines.japanese: 「うっ、ううう……こ、このひとが、いきなりわけの分からないことを言いながら……私の体に触ってきて……」
lines.english: “S-sob... Th-this man suddenly started saying things I couldn't understand... and touching my body...”

lines.japanese: おちゃめ大好き渡来さん、ここぞとばかりの泣き芝居だった。
lines.english: Our mischief-loving Watarai seized the opportunity and launched into a tearful performance.

lines.japanese: 「実は僕……さっきこいつに、この女を気絶させてくれって頼まれたんだ。あのときはてっきり冗談だと思っていたけれど……」
lines.english: “Actually... a little earlier, he asked me to knock this woman unconscious. I thought he was joking at the time, but...”

lines.japanese: ハチャメチャ大好き針生さんも、いつの間にかコスプレを脱いで市民Ａへとドレスダウンしていた。
lines.english: Our chaos-loving Hariu had somehow shed his costume and dressed down into Ordinary Citizen A.

lines.japanese: 「そういえば彼、さっき私にも、悩みがあれば相談に乗ると言って言葉巧みに近付こうとしてきました」
lines.english: “Come to think of it, he approached me earlier too. He told me to come to him with my troubles and tried to seduce me with clever words.”

lines.japanese: 空気読めちゃう山科さんは、いま現れたばかりにも関わらず級友らのいたずらに乗っかっていた。
lines.english: Yamashina, ever quick to read the room, joined her classmates' prank despite having only just arrived.

lines.japanese: 「お、女のひとを泣かせるのはいけないことだと思いますっ」
lines.english: “I-I think making a woman cry is wrong.”

lines.japanese: そしてめちゃめちゃ清らかな女神は、それだけ言いのこして走りさるのでありましたとさ。
lines.english: And with those few words, the impossibly pure goddess turned and ran away.

lines.japanese: ありがちありがち。
lines.english: Happens all the time.

lines.japanese: いや、ほんとに終わりだよ？
lines.english: No, seriously. That's the end.
